[SCENE]
Close editorial view of a small parchment-lined baking tray holding pale-golden scalloped shortbread cookie bases with generous neat swirls of caramel-brown manjar blanco, as in the first reference. Two finished powdered-sugar alfajores rest beside them. A pastry bag lies naturally on the tray edge. Recreate the real filling texture and cookie proportions, with more appetizing light and a calm composition.
[LENS & CAMERA]
85mm lens, f/5.6, low three-quarter angle, precise focus on real caramel swirls and crumbly shortbread.
[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
Match the real reference products: rustic pale-golden scalloped shortbread alfajores with caramel-brown dulce de leche and uneven powdered sugar, modest cookie thickness, natural pores and tiny baked imperfections. Retain the filling color and consistency from the original reference. The additional finished-image reference provides the photographic finish only.
[HUMAN ELEMENT]
No people or hands. Realistic traces of baking and sharing.
[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Cream linen, parchment, warm neutral kitchen surfaces, just a few natural crumbs and a subtle crimson textile accent. No invented kitchen equipment, excessive clutter or printed branding.
[LIGHTING]
Soft window from camera-left, 5000K daylight, warm cream bounce, gentle shadows, true-to-life white powdered sugar with preserved detail.
[ATMOSPHERE]
Warm intimate homemade bakery photography, believable and appetizing.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Cream, crimson, caramel and pale golden shortbread; restrained saturation.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Tactile handmade food photography, natural editorial lighting, restrained retouching, real crumb texture.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Tack-sharp commercial photography, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials, professional retouching standard.
[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words, no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects, no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look, no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash, no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions, no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look, no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones. No stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look, no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments, no perfect symmetry, no clipart elements, no flat illustration mixed with photo, no obviously composited backgrounds. No coconut, macarons, excessive filling or glossy dripping syrup.
resolution: 2k
